## Part 1

#Reading in data and making an altered tibble

```{r}
housedata <-read_csv("https://www4.stat.ncsu.edu/~online/ST308/Data/lbmoy2_house.csv")

housedata2 <- housedata %>% filter(LotShape != "IR2or3"&YearRemodAdd > 1963) %>% 
            mutate("SaleinHT" = SalePrice/100000) %>%
  select(-c(BsmtFinSF1, Neighborhood))

kable((housedata2)[1:10,1:6], format = "simple")
```



#Summary statistics of housedata
```{r}
sumhd2 <- housedata %>% group_by(Electrical) %>%
          summarize(meanSP = mean(SalePrice), stdSP = sd(SalePrice), quart1SP = quantile(SalePrice,probs = .25), quart3SP = quantile(SalePrice,probs = .75), 
                    meanGC = mean(GarageCars), stdGC = sd(GarageCars), quart1GC = quantile(GarageCars,probs = .25), quart3GC = quantile(GarageCars,probs = .75),
                    meanYB = mean(YearBuilt), stdYB = sd(YearBuilt), quart1YB = quantile(YearBuilt,probs = .25), quart3YB = quantile(YearBuilt,probs = .75))

kable((sumhd2), format = "simple")
```


#Creating graphs and models
```{r}
g <-ggplot(housedata, aes(x = GarageCars, y = SalePrice, color = Electrical))
g + geom_point()
```
Most of the Electrical types seem to be SBrkr and fewer are FuseA. Initally there is a mostly positive relationship between Garage car count and sales price, this changes with a count of 4 garage cars (this category has few data points so if there was more data a positive relationship still could be found).

#Creating a MLR model
```{r}
houselm <-lm(SalePrice~ GarageCars + YearBuilt, data = housedata)

summary(houselm)

predict(houselm, newdata = data.frame(GarageCars = c(2,4), YearBuilt= c(1977, 2000)))
```
Both of the main effects are significant as both are less than 0.01. There is significant evidence that Garage Cars and Year Built have an effect on the Sale Price.

# Custom Function for data of interest
```{r}
heartfunction = function(data,colname,group = NULL){

  new_data = data[,colname]
  
  idx = sapply(new_data,is.numeric)
  num_var = new_data[,idx]
  cat_var = new_data[,!idx]
  
  if (length(num_var) == 0){
    finallist = c()
  }
  if (length(cat_var) == 0){
    table = "NA"
  }
  if (length(num_var) != 0 ) {
    if (is.null(group )){ 
      mean <- sapply(num_var, mean) 
      var <- sapply(num_var, var) 
      quantiles <- sapply(num_var, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.95)) 
      finallist <- list( mean = mean, var = var, quantile = quantiles)
    }
         

    if (!is.null(group)){ # 
      finallist <- data %>% group_by(group) %>% summarize(mean = sapply(num_var, mean), var <- sapply(num_var, var), quantiles <- sapply(num_var, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.95)) )
      }
  }
  if (length(cat_var) != 0 ){
    table <- table(cat_var)
}
  return(list(finallist, table = table)) 
  
}
#heartfunction(heartdata, c("chol"), group = heartdata$sex)
heartfunction(heartdata,c("trestbps", "thalach"))
heartfunction(heartdata,c("ca","thal"))


```
